video_title: How will the Giannis trade affect the rest of the NBA offseason? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo trade impact on NBA draft and team movement
quotes.excerpt: one big piece that if you pull it out then the entire tower starts to fall

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: I think this is a game of Jenga and there is one big piece that if you pull it out then the entire tower starts to fall and that is Giannis Antetokounmpo. Not just because of course we have been talking for months about what the decision is going to be with Giannis and the Milwaukee Bucks, but how that actually affects the way teams want to move around and picks fly around in this draft.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: One of the reasons why the league is a little bit frozen right now is not just because of who might get Giannis, it is the second and third layer. This is going to be a very large multi-player trade and there might open up opportunities for third, fourth, fifth, even fifth teams to get in on this.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard trade impact on Jrue Holiday and championship race
quotes.excerpt: Damian Lillard goes to Milwaukee and it ends up allowing Jrue Holiday to move to Boston
quotes.quote: A couple of years ago we saw Damian Lillard as one of the big trades in the off-season. Damian Lillard goes to Milwaukee and it ends up allowing Jrue Holiday to move to Boston. And that move, Jrue Holiday ending up in Boston, ended up being impactful in the championship race. You have a team like the Lakers, for example, sitting there with potentially a lot of salary cap space. Who is to say that this potential trade with Giannis doesn't open up an opportunity for them to get in and get a player that could potentially help them?

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Strategic draft pick management for teams pursuing Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: can you take 10 and 13, your other first and potentially get into the top eight
quotes.quote: I think you have to have something concrete by the night of the draft. If you are looking at a team like Miami who is at pick 13 and certainly they are in play with Giannis, if you are the Bucks, you want to have an idea because you would be picking for the Heat in that situation. Or if you had the 13th pick, let us say something happens over the weekend, can you take 10 and 13, your other first and potentially get into the top eight in this year's draft? Brian hit it right on the head, there is a part one to this trade and then there is going to be a part two, three and potentially four as something else that could happen here.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Draft class depth and potential for long-term guard development
quotes.excerpt: you are anticipating you are drafting a guard that can be your lead guard for the next decade
quotes.quote: You mentioned the Clippers at five, that is where the draft really becomes fun because you have got some guard play there where you are anticipating you are drafting a guard that can be your lead guard for the next decade. That is how deep and how talented this draft is at the guard position in particular. And so for the Bucks, if they are able to make a move because of Giannis and trade up, this has been a draft class that came into college basketball with a ton of hype and that hype was met with the production that it had on the court. Now they enter into the NBA draft with that same kind of hype and the question is, will they deliver on that same kind of expectation?
